comment: Placements of the ALICE Run 3 geometry that the navigator already cannot reach, so that o2-sim-geometry-doctor --reachability-only can be used as a build gate on new ones while these are still open. Each is a daughter that lies in a part of its mother the mother does not occupy: the beam-pipe vacuum sits in the hole of the thin shell it was placed inside, and the MCH quadrant volumes sit outside SQM1/SQM2. Remove an entry once its placement is fixed; the gate will then keep it fixed.

known_unreachable.why: PIPE: the A-side beam-pipe vacuum is placed inside the aluSideA shell, which is hollow between its own Rmin and Rmax, so the vacuum lies in the hole
